title: D4: VTC source of truth (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: Agora spec §6 remains source of truth for media, signaling, SFU, TURN, recording. Borrow jmap-vtc features (ring incl. multi-device, scheduled calls, lobby, call policy, breakout rooms) as MLS group messages, client-enforced or by a CO bot where one decider is needed (e.g. lobby admission). First-answer-wins by group message order. No call server that knows participants.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-16 and applied in spec (13, 05, 06, 11, 14, profiles of jmap family)
